items.ask: 1. Add SMS alerts to applicants at each stage of application processing. Estimated effort: 25 person-days.
quotes: Given an application moves from "Draft" to "Submitted", when the transition WF-T1 is saved, then the SMS is sent to the applicant within 5 minutes with all placeholders filled and its delivery status is recorded.

Given an application moves from "Pending institution verification" to "Pending district approval", when the transition WF-T3 is saved, then the SMS is sent to the applicant within 5 minutes with all placeholders filled and its delivery status is recorded.

Given an application moves from "Pending district approval" to "Rejected", when the transition WF-T7 is saved, then the SMS is sent to the applicant within 5 minutes with all placeholders filled and its delivery status is recorded.

Given an application moves from "Pending district approval" to "Sanctioned", when the transition WF-T6 is saved, then the SMS is sent to the applicant within 5 minutes with all placeholders filled and its delivery status is recorded.

Given an application moves from "Under appeal" to "Pending district approval", when the transition WF-T10 is saved, then the SMS is sent to the applicant within 5 minutes with all placeholders filled and its delivery status is recorded.

Given an application moves from "Payment initiated" to "Payment failed", when the transition WF-T14 is saved, then the SMS is sent to the applicant within 5 minutes with all placeholders filled and its delivery status is recorded.
items.reasoning: The change request proposes adding SMS alerts at each stage, which is fully covered by the baseline requirements FR-NOT-001, FR-NOT-002, FR-NOT-005, FR-NOT-004, FR-NOT-006, and FR-NOT-009.

blocks.INPUT:
Change Request No. CR-07
Project: State Post-Matric Scholarship Portal
From: Vendor project manager, M/s Techsys Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Date: 28 October 2026

The following changes have been requested during development. They were not part of our original understanding and are submitted for approval with the estimated additional effort.

1. Add SMS alerts to applicants at each stage of application processing. Estimated effort: 25 person-days.
2. Provide a district-wise dashboard of pending applications for District Social Welfare Officers. Estimated effort: 15 person-days.
3. Integrate with the Income Tax department API for verification of the declared family income. Estimated effort: 40 person-days.

Total additional effort: 80 person-days.
